headline: Weathered Expanse Tilts to Colonials as Warden Holdings Slip to 145
war_summary: Three hours of war have recolored the Weathered Expanse: the map now shows seven strongholds there under Colonial colors against two Warden, the last unclaimed ground occupied, after fifty-two recorded actions in the day with Shattered Advance and Wightwalk the busiest posts. The wider ledger now reads 291 strategic works Colonial to 145 Warden, none lying neutral, against 280-154 with two ruins at our last filing. Callahan's Passage still blazes — sixteen logged actions and near a thousand casualties to each account in two hours, though the hourly pace has slackened — while Stlican Shelf, with eleven actions inside the same span about Breaker Town and The Pale House, and Linn of Mercy keep their casualty rolls heavy. At Marban Hollow the posts about Mox churned to within minutes of press, and Viper Pit's Blackthroat saw losses leap suddenly in the closing hours. The Dead Lands and Godcrofts, turbulent yesterday, have cooled; Farranac Coast and Stonecradle fly quiet flags despite stiff recent rolls. It is day 206; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and neither side is named victor.
